Title: Frozen Shoulder Isn't From Overuse - Here's What Really Causes It

Description:
Most people blame frozen shoulder on bad posture or overuse, but that's usually not the trigger. Research points to three quieter drivers: prolonged shoulder immobilization after injury or surgery, poor blood sugar control, and untreated thyroid problems - one meta-analysis found diabetics have nearly 3.7 times higher odds of developing it. Here's what actually helps protect your shoulder.
